title: Pain sensation during different training approaches under blood flow restriction
summary: Pain sensation during BFR training is supposed to be analysed for this study. Therefore participants take part in six different training modalities. Data analysis is going to compare pain sensation.

interventions.name: oBFR: training with 30% of 1 repetition maximum with ongoing BFR under 50% of arterial limp occlusition pressure (LOP)
osBFR: training with 30% of 1 repetition maximum with BFR (50% LOP) during training sets
bsBFR: training with 30% of 1 repetition maximum with BFR (50% LOP) between training sets
preBFR: training with 30% of 1 repetition maximum with BFR (100% LOP) for 10 minutes before training sets
bikeBFR: training with 30% of 1 repetition maximum with 10 minutes bike ergometer under BFR (50% LOP) before training sets
LI: training with 30% of 1 repetition maximum without BFR

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- written consent for participation in this study
-written adhesion and privacy policy after intense explnation and information
-age between 18 and 45
-phsician acceptance orthopedic and anaesthesian
-no limitation in contralateral arm
Exclusion criteria:
-acute or chronic tumor or immun supression
-acute or chronic illness of vascular system (e.g. arterial hypertension > grade 2 (RR >160/100 afterESC-guideline 2018))
-previous vascular surgery on arteries on upper extremity
-sickle cell anemia
-pregnancy or breast feeding
